theorem_statement: Every nonregistered cycle in the 120-cycle third-order frontier carries the same six-vertex external relay: four endpoint vertices joined completely to two middle vertices, forming an induced K2,4. The two middle vertices occupy one quotient chamber and are related by one fixed native V4 element. Registered cycles carry no such long-range relay.

interpretation.earned: The sixteen long external walks are generated by one small relay graph rather than sixteen unrelated paths.
interpretation.structural_selector: Registered closure is selected by absence of the uniform K2,4 external relay.
